purpose: After two bounded command-line transport failures with zero form bytes, inspect the public official form through the already available user browser once for NFCI identity, observation bounds and vintage-date selector. Do not request/download series values.
method: One new Chrome tab navigation to exact official URL; read visible DOM once and, if present, query only form fields and vintage option values through read-only browser API. Save source identity, rendered DOM selector metadata and observation date bounds as a compact receipt. Any DOM export is rendered evidence, not original HTTP response bytes or historical first-public proof.
stop: If navigation is blocked, no exact NFCI form, no vintage selector, or source identity ambiguous, preserve failure and stop. Even a populated selector only qualifies possible vintage availability, not values, release-time coverage or alpha.
